2607.14185.title: Closed-Loop Knowledge Dynamics: An Operational Framework for Saturation and Escape
2607.14185.paper_summary: Feedback-driven loops support iterative improvement in large language models, reinforcement learning, and autonomous discovery, yet their gains often diminish under repeated internal feedback. We study why closed-loop knowledge systems saturate and what external information can move them beyond their current attractors. We introduce a three-level operational framework in which knowledge states $x_t$ evolve through transition kernels $K_θ$ indexed by a structural parameter $θ$. The governing structure is defined as the observational equivalence class of $θ$ induced by these kernels, while attractors and basins are properties of the fixed-$θ$ dynamics. A structural intervention changes $θ$ and produces a detectable kernel discrepancy on pre-specified probe states, making structural change falsifiable. Using a Lyapunov drift condition, we show that stable internal dynamics approach bounded stability regions with exponentially attenuated transients and a noise-controlled residual floor. We characterize escape through a metric condition on intervention-induced attractor displacement and a baseline-relative KL lower bound for increasing escape probability. This analysis also explains why conditional mutual information alone cannot certify escape: it measures variation among intervention-conditioned updates rather than departure from the no-intervention law. Case studies in LLM code repair, sparse-reward reinforcement learning, and Bayesian optimization use matched continuation controls to illustrate how feedback strength and alignment affect quality-improving escape. Our contribution is an operational connection among stability tools, measurable intervention effects, and cross-domain diagnostics.
2607.14185.paper_summary_zh: 反饋驅動的迴圈支持大型語言模型、強化學習和自主發現中的迭代改進，但它們的增益在重複的內部反饋下往往會減少。我們研究為什麼閉環知識系統會飽和，以及什麼外部信息可以使它們超越當前的吸引子。我們引入了一個三層操作框架，其中知識狀態 $x_t$ 通過由結構參數 $θ$ 指定的轉移核 $K_θ$ 進化。治理結構被定義為這些核所引起的 $θ$ 的觀察等價類，而吸引子和盆地則是固定 $θ$ 動力學的特性。結構性干預改變 $θ$ 並在預先指定的探測狀態上產生可檢測的核差異，使結構變化可被證偽。利用 Lyapunov 漂移條件，我們表明穩定的內部動力學接近有界穩定區域，伴隨著指數衰減的瞬態和噪聲控制的剩餘底線。我們通過對干預引起的吸引子位移的度量條件以及相對基線的 KL 下界來表徵逃逸，以提高逃逸概率。這一分析還解釋了為什麼僅依賴條件互信息無法證明逃逸：它測量的是干預條件更新之間的變異，而不是偏離無干預法則的情況。在 LLM 代碼修復、稀疏獎勵強化學習和貝葉斯優化的案例研究中，使用匹配的延續控制來說明反饋強度和對齊如何影響質量改進逃逸。我們的貢獻是穩定性工具、可測量的干預效果和跨領域診斷之間的操作性聯繫。
